notes.title: Patch 1.1 Released
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
 Fixed kill/wave count bug on game over screen (will no longer display 0)
 Improved load times for title screen (please be patient)
Game Changes
 Reduced spawn rate of all waves by 10%
 HP of Chads and Naruto Running Chads has been decreased by 20%
 Ammo spawn rate has been increased by 15%
